import urllib.request
import csv

url = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1NQU2SGVykYL3n35NgzL78R0fszK0vt5yacNSV151wYI/export?format=csv&gid=1781095899'

reader = csv.reader(data.splitlines())
rows = list(reader)

t_col = 19 # T列
ae_col = 30 # AE列

matches = []
for i, row in enumerate(rows[2:], start=3): # row 3 is data index 0 (1-indexed row number in sheet)
    if len(row) > max(t_col, ae_col):

        ae_val = row[ae_col].strip()
        if t_val != '':
            matches.append((i, row))

print(f'Total rows with T checked: {len(matches)}')
uncompleted = []
for r_num, row in matches:
    ae_val = row[ae_col].strip()
    if ae_val == '':
        uncompleted.append((r_num, row))

print(f'Uncompleted (T checked & AE empty): {len(uncompleted)}')
for r_num, row in uncompleted[:10]:
    patient_id = row[3] if len(row) > 3 else ''
    name_info = row[4] if len(row) > 4 else ''
    商材 = row[1] if len(row) > 1 else ''
    t_val = row[t_col]
    print(f'Row {r_num}: 商材={商材}, 患者ID={patient_id}, T値={t_val}, 氏名/リンク={name_info[:50]}')
"
